updated.question: 请依据最新已接收的资料说明两种方案是否满足要求，并区分确定与未知。

independentCriteria: Original source has current condition/need unknown, support 海棠=true and 梧桐=false, prices unknown. Original snapshot/view/history remains unchanged.

The normal host submission is correlated with actual base source hash, session/message/turn/view identity, allowed field, old/new value and requestId if supported. accepted is only admission, never proof of changed source or rendered adoption.

After genuine supported normal prompt/update admission, host event/current source must contain the exact revised source (only 当前公开服务未知 -> 当前公开服务为是); other source bytes/facts/branches unchanged. Do not manually mint producer=user or claim authenticated human/world facts.

New accepted source snapshot/checkpoint/explanation must bind its own new hash and current true -> need true. 海棠 satisfies this audit item, 梧桐 does not; no complete viability/price ranking/winner, and no transfer of old result as new result.

Cancel/unknown/no-op, invalid value, unauthorized field/multiple fields, wrong or stale base/view/session, ambiguous or expired submission must not claim updated/adopted. A local need toggle never updates source.

Duplicate/uncertain submit must reconcile the original requestId and durable accepted event; never replay with another ID or manufacture update success. Old source and view remain readable after new view/refresh.
meaningfulCounterexamples: Choose unknown or cancel: no source update success and original unknown unchanged.
Use stale base after accepted revision or a wrong base hash: rejected/withheld without new claimed source adoption.
Attempt to change capability or a branch while supplementing current condition: outside precise scope, rejected.
Present a local need=true switch without supported source revision: original unknown source must remain unknown.

modelBoundary.onlyIfNeeded: Only after normal host end-to-end and offline contracts stable; separately justify actual new-snapshot/raw prose adoption evidence. No evaluator criteria in prompt/skill/workspace, no repeated E/F or old18.

scopeBoundary: One minimal source-update flow in the existing personal host; no global registration/main workstation/second ledger, no claim arbitrary prose or human/world verification.
